claims.text: The hotel is at 42 Avenue Gabriel, midway between Avenue Montaigne and Rue du Faubourg St-Honore, a stone's throw from the Champs-Elysees.

findings.quote: 42 AVENUE GABRIEL, A CAPITAL ADDRESS
Midway between Avenue Montaigne and Rue du Faubourg St-Honoré, a stone’s throw from the Champs-Elysées

claims.text: The hotel overlooks the Eiffel Tower, the Pantheon, the Grand Palais and the Concorde obelisk.

findings.quote: overlooks some of the city’s key sights: the Eiffel Tower, the Pantheon, the Grand Palais and the Concorde obelisk

claims.text: The building was built in 1854 as a private residence for the Duc de Morny, Napoleon III's half-brother.

findings.quote: Originally built in 1854 as a private residence for Napoleon III’s half-brother, the Duc de Morny

claims.text: Under Michel Reybier's ownership and after a redesign overseen by Jacques Garcia, it opened as La Reserve in 2015.

findings.quote: under the ownership of Michel Reybier and following a top-to-bottom redesign overseen by Jacques Garcia, it opened as La Réserve in 2015

claims.text: Le Gabriel serves the cuisine of chef Jerome Banctel.

findings.quote: discover or rediscover cuisine by Jérôme Banctel

claims.text: La Pagode offers French cuisine that highlights brasserie-inspired dishes.

findings.quote: offers resolutely French cuisine in which tradition is expressed with acute precision
the Chef revels in enhancing brasserie-inspired must-haves

claims.text: Bar Le Gaspard suits a business meeting, an after-work get-together, cocktails or a glass of champagne.

findings.quote: ideal for a business meeting, a relaxed afterwork get-together, a cocktail with friends or a glass of champagne for two, Bar Le Gaspard

claims.text: La Pagode uses the inner courtyard, and Le Gaspard the streetside area in front of the hotel.

findings.quote: the inner courtyard, in the case of La Pagode, and the streetside area directly in front of the hotel in the case of Le Gaspard

claims.text: Spa Nescens has an indoor pool, a hammam, a fitness studio and treatment rooms.

findings.quote: With its 16m-long indoor pool, hammam, fitness studio and three treatment rooms, Spa Nescens

claims.text: Hairdressing (cut and blow-dry) can be provided in your room.

findings.quote: Hairdressing services (cut and blow-dry) can be provided in the comfort of your room.

claims.text: The entire hotel is wheelchair-accessible, with two Prestige Junior Suite rooms designed for guests with reduced mobility.

findings.quote: The entire hotel is wheelchair-accessible, and two rooms in the Prestige Junior Suite category have been specifically designed for guests with reduced mobility.

claims.text: A significant proportion of the rooms and suites can be connected.

findings.quote: a significant proportion of the rooms and suites can be connected.

claims.text: The book-lined Duc de Morny Library has remained much as it was since the 2015 opening.

findings.quote: The Duc de Morny Library, meanwhile, remains very much as it has been since the hotel’s opening in 2015—a book-lined sliver of sumptuousness

claims.text: In the rooms, the furniture is by Henryot, the silk wallpaper by Rubelli and the fabric headboards by Prelle.

findings.quote: The furniture is by Henryot, the silk wallpaper by Rubelli, the fabric headboards by Prelle

claims.text: The concierge can arrange an after-hours visit to Marie-Antoinette's boudoir at Versailles or a helicopter day trip to Champagne.

findings.quote: Should you hanker for an after-hours visit to Marie-Antoinette’s boudoir at Versailles, for instance, or a day trip to Champagne by helicopter, they can of course make the necessary arrangements

claims.text: Nescens is a Swiss brand whose products are sold exclusively by the spa at La Reserve Paris.

findings.quote: Nescens, a Swiss brand whose products are exclusively sold by the Spa at La Réserve Paris

claims.text: For children, tipis, rocking horses, and popcorn and cotton-candy machines are available on request.

findings.quote: Tipis, rocking horses, and even popcorn and cotton-candy machines are available on request.

claims.text: The hotel has no kids' club.

findings.quote: despite the absence of a kids’ club

claims.text: The spa has just three treatment rooms.

findings.quote: Set around the 16-meter indoor pool are just three treatment rooms
three treatment rooms

claims.text: There is no formal reception; the Louis XV Salon serves that purpose.

findings.quote: there’s no reception, as such, at La Réserve, just the so-called Louis XV Salon, which, furnished in period-specific splendour, serves an approximately reception-like purpose perfectly well
